content_type.description: Content type of the note. Currently only `PLAIN_TEXT` is supported.

user_id.description: ID of the user that created the note. Defaults to the first admin user found.

teamtailor.description: Teamtailor specific remote fields for the note.

greenhouse.description: Greenhouse specific remote fields for the note.

is_json.description: Whether the note is in a stringified JSON format. If true, content should contain a valid JSON as per the [Recruitee API documentation](https://docs.recruitee.com/reference/candidatesidnotes) (body_json field). If false we add the note as a plain text.

recruitee.description: Recruitee specific remote fields for the note.

action.description: The action (or type) associated with a Note. You can find all available note actions in a Bullhorn instance under System Settings > commentActionList. The default action is `Note`.

bullhorn.description: Bullhorn specific remote fields for the note.

perform_as.description: ID of the Lever user that will show up as having created the note. If not provided, defaults to the user associated with the OAuth token.

lever.description: Lever specific remote fields for the note.

allOf.description: Tool specific remote fields for the note.

On-Behalf-Of.description: ID of the the user that will show up as having performed the action in Greenhouse. We already pass a value by default, but you can use this to override it.

post_headers.description: Headers we will pass with `POST` requests to Greenhouse.

on_behalf_of_user_remote_id.description: The remote ID of the user that will be displayed in the UI as the one that performed the action.

workable.description: Workable specific remote fields for ATS actions.

allOf.description: Additional fields that we will pass through to specific ATS systems.

remote_fields.description: Tool specific remote fields for the note.
